OPS-14.agent_note: ANSWERED BY ME 2026-10-04. Never used, and this is correct. Measured on this host: 102 layers in ~/.local/share/containers/storage/overlay-images/, all pulled by digest from a registry - no 'podman store' entry exists. Why it matters: 'store' is short names that live in a single mutable layer, so a digest pin and a store name cannot both exist for one image. Pinning to sha256 digests is what makes the install verifiable (README 4.1 rule 9); a store would break that by letting a tag silently repoint. Every Quadlet pulls digest-pinned. So: keep the current model, never adopt store.
